description: Source code for a webhook server handling voice call webhooks, including WebSocket media streams, verification, and auto-responses.

classes.name: VoiceCallWebhookServer
classes.description: HTTP server class for handling voice call webhooks, WebSocket media streams, verification, and auto-responses.

methods.name: getMediaStreamHandler
methods.description: Returns the media stream handler for wiring to provider.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the webhook server, initializing media streaming if enabled.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the webhook server and cleans up resources.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests and runs the webhook pipeline.

methods.name: runWebhookPipeline
methods.description: Processes the webhook request, verifies, and parses events.

methods.name: isRealtimeWebSocketUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if the request is a WebSocket upgrade for real-time streams.

methods.name: shouldShortCircuitToRealtimeTwiml
methods.description: Determines if request should be handled as a real-time TwiML response.

methods.name: readBody
methods.description: Reads request body with timeout and size limit.

methods.name: handleInboundResponse
